events.title: New HackerCraft Award
events.description: Omniscient added the HackerCraft Blue award to cover server costs at $15 USD. Unlike previous HackerCraft awards, this one is not awarded in-game and is only available when upcoming fees are due. 85 users purchased the award within 9 hours before sales were suspended.

events.title: Closed Account Policy Revised
events.description: To limit access to financial data, awards belonging to members with closed accounts have been revoked. Additionally, the awardees of all donation awards except Gift are no longer publicly listed.

events.title: SuperCell Games Forum Introduced
events.description: The Clash of Clans subforum was expanded to cover all games from SuperCell Games, now found in the Mobile and Tablet Gaming section.

events.title: Trust Scan Improvement (#3)
events.description: Omniscient updated the Trust Scan feature for the third time, adding color coding and additional improvements to entries.

events.title: HackerCraft = Non-Profit
events.description: Omniscient clarified that HackerCraft is a non-profit project and that no payments should be sent to any staff member of the server. He also detailed other ways to support the server.

events.title: Group leadership changes
events.description: Mr Kewl is now a leader of The Brotherhood. Fiber is no longer a leader of Minecrafters. NeoCode is no longer a leader of Minecrafters.
